title: CSR portal: policy search, assisted intake, recent claims
contracts: architecture/contracts/openapi.yaml (auth/token, claims/{id}/coverage, policies/{policyNumber}/snapshot, intake/sessions*, claims list, config/public)
acceptance: src/web/csr/index.html (plus app.js and pure modules) loads at /csr with a dev-login panel (tenant select, role fixed to csr) that is hidden when dev mode is off

Policy search by policy number/name calls the coverage search endpoint defined in openapi.yaml (policies/{policyNumber}/snapshot or the search path present in the spec; builder documents which) and lists results with select action

Assisted intake uses the same intake session API with channel 'csr' and the selected policyNumber, shows the current question, and a side panel listing required items still missing plus a scripted prompt derived from the question help text
Submit creates the claim, shows claim number and a button/link to open the claim; recent claims list from GET /claims (tenant-scoped, newest first) with keyboard-operable table
Missing endpoints or network failure show a 'service unavailable' state with retry, no uncaught errors
Uses the shared kit components for table, stepper, toast; same accessibility bar (labels, focus management, aria-live, skip link, 320px+ layout)

Tests in tests/unit/web/csr/ with a fake api cover search, missing-items computation, scripted prompt selection, submit, and unavailable state; node --test --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning tests/unit/web/csr/ passes
brief:
Build the CSR portal under src/web/csr/ against openapi.yaml; backend may be mid-flight, so tolerate failures.

KIT INTERFACE (agreed now so apps build in parallel; S1-EXP-01 implements exactly this, apps import it): src/web/shared/api.js exports createApiClient({baseUrl='/api/v1', getToken, fetchImpl=fetch}) returning {get,post,put,patch,del,upload(path,FormData)} that return parsed JSON and throw ApiError {status,code,message,details,requestId} from the error envelope; network failure/5xx/404-on-missing-route throws ApiError with code 'service_unavailable'. src/web/shared/i18n.js exports t(key,params), setLocale, getLocale, registerStrings(locale,table), supportedLocales (en, es). src/web/shared/theme.js exports applyBranding(publicConfig), setScheme('light'|'dark'|'auto'). src/web/shared/devlogin.js exports devLogin(api,{tenant,role}) -> {token,principal}. Components are custom elements registered on import of src/web/shared/components/index.js: fx-field, fx-chips, fx-stepper, fx-upload, fx-chat, fx-timeline, fx-toast, fx-table. Each is attribute/property driven and emits CustomEvents named 'fx-change' (detail {value}) / 'fx-submit'. Shared CSS: src/web/shared/tokens.css and components.css. Apps put pure logic (state, view-models, API orchestration) in plain modules taking an injected api and t, so node tests need no DOM or kit.
Import the kit by absolute path (/shared/...) only in browser-side files; keep pure logic (search.js, assisted.js computing missing required items from the IntakeStep/IntakeSession answers vs required questions and scripted prompt from question.help with a fallback to the prompt text, recent.js, strings.js registering csr.* en/es) free of kit imports, taking injected {api, t}. Tests use a hand-written fake api.

Flow: devLogin as csr for chosen tenant (dev only, token in memory); search; select policy; start session {lob, channel:'csr', policyNumber}; answer loop as in the intake API (server evaluates showIf); side panel updates each step using the progress/required info in IntakeStep (read the schema; if missing-required list is not provided, derive it from session answers plus the question list, and note the gap in a contract-change request to the architecture hub: node org/cli.mjs post architecture contract-change "..." --ticket S1-EXP-03); submit with Idempotency-Key; open claim link goes to /csr?claim=<id> showing a read-only claim summary from GET /claims/{id}. Pitfalls: textContent only for user data; mask nothing client-side but never log PII to console; write only your paths; run only your tests; no real carrier or person names.

verdicts.reason: All criteria met; 20/20 tests pass; csr_phone channel (enum has no 'csr') and snapshot-lookup search documented via contract-change; no innerHTML/console, dev panel gated. Note: UI never browser-run.

escapedDefects.summary: CSR disclosure question sends string, server requires boolean: CSRs cannot finish personal_auto intakes
